name: UI kit 3: a scrolling list (wheel, drag, scroll bar, clipped rows), a drop-down, tabs and an inventory slot to slot drag and drop, all driven with the mouse through the input tool

steps.note: the list starts a little way down: the first row is partly above the viewport

expect.name: Items view
expect.message: the content is the column of twelve rows, measured

steps.note: a row half out of the bottom of the viewport answers the pointer only in the half that shows

expect.name: Item 6
expect.message: pointer in the visible part of row 6

expect.name: Item 6
expect.message: the same row under the pointer, but below the viewport

steps.note: the wheel: a notch down moves the content up by 0.06

expect.name: Item 1
expect.message: the rows moved with it

expect.name: Items view
expect.message: a pointer that is not over the list does not scroll it

steps.note: to the end: the last row stops at the bottom of the viewport
a click on a row is a click (and the system counts it); a drag of the content is not

expect.message: row 12 was clicked

expect.name: Items view
expect.message: the pointer moved 0.15 with the button held: the content follows it

expect.name: Items view
expect.message: pulled down by 0.15 like paper under a finger: the offset is 0.15 smaller
letting go after a drag is not a click on whatever was under the pointer

steps.note: the scroll bar: dragging its thumb to the top scrolls the list to the top

expect.name: Items view
expect.message: the thumb is at the top, so is the list

steps.note: the drop-down: the header shows the picked option (Medium, index 1), the list is hidden until a click on the header

expect.name: Quality header
expect.message: a click on the header opens the list

steps.note: the list is over the scene: a press outside it closes it and is not also a click on the button under the pointer (the More button of the Stats panel)

expect.name: Stats button
expect.message: the list does not cover it, so the pointer is over it

expect.name: Stats button
expect.message: the press that closed the list does not reach the button
nothing was picked

steps.note: open it again and pick High, the third option

expect.name: Quality header
expect.message: changed for the tick of the pick

steps.note: tabs: the Stats panel is shown; its More button is under the pointer, the one of the Items panel in the same place is not

expect.name: Items button
expect.message: hidden with its panel
the second tab

expect.name: Items button
expect.message: now the other one answers

steps.note: drag and drop: the sword sits in slot A; carry it to slot B and let go

expect.name: Sword
expect.message: pressed on the sword: it is held

expect.name: Slot B
expect.message: between the slots: over nothing

expect.name: Slot B
expect.message: over slot B

a graph system saw the one drop

expect.name: Sword

steps.note: picked up again and dropped on nothing: it snaps back into slot B and nothing is reported
tooltip: the pointer rests on the sword (in slot B now); the box comes up near it after 0.4 s, on the left of the pointer because it would not fit on the right
